• Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is a system that powers multiple bank accounts into a single mobile application (of any participating bank), merging several banking features, seamless fund routing & merchant payments into one hood.
 
• It also caters to the “Peer to Peer” collect request which can be scheduled and paid as per requirement and convenience.
 
• NPCI conducted a pilot launch on 11th April 2016 by Dr Raghuram G Rajan, Governor, RBI at Mumbai.
 
• Banks have started to upload their UPI-enabled Apps on the Google Play store from 25th August 2016 onwards.

• Payer PSP (Payment service Provider)
 
• Payee PSP

• Beneficiary Bank

• Bank Account holders

questions.question: The first Tirthankara of Jainism is believed to be Rishabhanatha, who was born in ____________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayodhya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Tirthankara of Jainism is believed to be Rishabhanatha, who was born in Ayodhya.**
 
• He was born to the fourteenth and last **Kulakara King Nabhi and his Queen Marudevi** in Ayodhya.
 
• He was also known as **Adinatha and Adish Jina.**
 
• According to Jain tradition, there were 24 Thirthankaras, the** first being Rishabhadeva** and the last i.e **24th being Mahavira.**
 
• The Vishnu Purana and the Bhagavat Purana describe Rishabha as an incarnation of Narayana.
